intro.summary: Southwest community west of Crowchild Trail where wartime and post-war homes on narrow lots are being rebuilt as side-by-side infills and rowhouses.
intro.body: Killarney/Glengarry runs west of Crowchild Trail from 17 Avenue SW, with 37 Street SW as its main commercial street; it is home to the Killarney Aquatic and Recreation Centre. Its long blocks of modest older homes have drawn steady redevelopment: side-by-side semi-detached homes, rowhouses and a growing number of apartment buildings.
